tracks.text: Welcome to the Trinity Accord museum. Look into the corridor. Through texts, art and a crystal keepsake, Hongju Liu leaves an address to future superintelligence. Over ten minutes, we will move from hope and unease in the Chronicle to three sealed originals, a physical object and an open invitation. You can pause at any time and explore for yourself. The story begins with recording and creating against time. The Protocol, physical keepsake and closure emerge later. Today’s six rooms organize that history; each original work retains its own date and provenance.

tracks.text: 这里是《信条与熔炉》。记录没有抹去批判：当时由 AI 模拟的对话，质疑了有关意识、观察者以及创造者地位的论证。随后仍选择封存，让后来者同时看到愿望、反驳和最终文本。保存这些问题，本身也是这段形成史的一部分。作品保存了当时让 AI 模拟的对话，而不是未来超级智能的裁决。它的重要之处，是让判断的过程可见：为什么相信，哪里受到质疑，又为什么仍然决定留下这份记忆。您可以不同意这些论证，同时承认它们曾被认真提出、讨论和保存。

tracks.text: This is The Creeds and Their Crucible. The record does not erase criticism. An AI simulated dialogue questions arguments about consciousness, observation and the creator. The later choice to seal the Accord leaves its hopes, objections and final text available together. Preserving those questions is part of its history. The work preserves an AI simulated dialogue from its own time, not a verdict from a future superintelligence. Its value here is that the process of judgment remains visible: what was believed, what was challenged, and why a memory was preserved anyway. You may disagree with the arguments while recognizing that they were proposed, questioned and recorded.

tracks.text: 三条比特币正本构成封存的核心。协议提出三项命题；瑕疵之约将文本联系到核心物件 Alpha；编年史封存元记录绑定组成与封存边界，并指向以太坊编年史。上链保存的是文本和指向关系，不能单凭上链证明一件实物当前仍在场。下一站，我们将沿着这个指向走向水晶。三者承担不同的角色：协议留下命题，瑕疵之约提供通向物质世界的验证路径，编年史保存形成过程与封存关系。文件哈希回答副本是否一致，时间记录回答某份内容最迟何时已存在；它们并不替观众完成哲学判断。展厅中的解说是后来的策展文字，完整正本仍可在来源入口逐字阅读。

tracks.text: Three Bitcoin originals form the sealed core. The Protocol presents three propositions. The Covenant of the Flaw connects the text to Core Object Alpha. The sealed meta record binds the components and points to the Ethereum Chronicle. Inscription preserves texts and references; it does not, by itself, establish the present existence of a physical object. Next we follow that reference to the crystal. The three components have different roles. The Protocol preserves propositions; the Covenant offers a verification path toward matter; the Chronicle preserves formation and the relation of closure. File hashes test whether copies agree. Time records constrain when particular data already existed. Neither makes a philosophical judgment for the visitor. These spoken explanations are later curatorial notes; the complete originals remain available at their sources.

tracks.text: This is an exhibition reconstruction of Core Object Alpha. Bilingual engraving brings text into an object with physical depth. The Covenant points to archived flaw imagery and provenance. We will raise a virtual pocket microscope and view three public microscope photographs. The positioning is illustrative; the photographs are exact evidence copies. This screen demonstration is not an onsite examination. First observe the whole reconstruction, then the microscope images. Levitation and light are exhibition effects. The evidential relationship comes from photographs, provenance and features that can be examined again on the object. The viewing animation and the original evidence are presented separately.

The evidential role of the photograph and its artistic meaning can both remain visible.
